summary: Iteration 8 backend testing of PDF background alignment fix + copyright placement + COMP PDF background. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_pdf_alignment.py (13 tests) and ran alongside existing test_iteration7_pdf_layout.py (7 tests) — ALL 20 PASSED. Paid PDF: exactly 2 pages; page1 has 3 images (bg, jingalala, QR) with NO 'Copyright' text; page2 has 1 image (bg) + BOTH T&C sections (Entry Ticket + Chungath Redemption) + copyright line 'Copyright 2026 RajaOnam - Powered by Event Ticketing Solutions by Berrysys Media Global LLC'. Page 1 text starts with BOOKING ID (no standalone 'RajaOnam 2026' heading). Aspect-preserved fit-by-height on cream background works correctly. Cleaned up bookings collection to empty (removed 3 leftover test bookings from prior sessions: EO-VDTH2P/EO-0Z1G69/EO-ZJAPQA — all clearly test data 'PDF Design', 'BG Align', 'Comp BG').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1211 lines — consider splitting PDF generation (make_ticket_pdf ~115 lines) into a separate module (e.g., pdf_ticket.py) for maintainability.
Copyright string is duplicated at lines 594 and 617 — extract to a module-level constant to avoid drift.
draw_bg() image dimensions (768x1368) are hard-coded; if source asset is swapped this could distort. Consider reading actual image dims via PIL or storing dims as a constant with a comment.
